records.notes: Visible forms show substantial hamza, alif, and pronoun-form differences across the editions, including Hafs ءَامَنتُم and the other distinct forms; no source-error claim is made.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh uses اٰذَنَ and Susi omits the final stopping/presentation mark, while the consonantal form is preserved.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰمَنَّا while the other editions show ءَامَنَّا, an initial alif/hamza presentation difference.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰيَةٖ while the other editions show ءَايَةٖ, an initial alif/hamza presentation difference.
The visible lexical form إسراءيل is consistent; Warsh/Qalun differ in dagger-alif and stopping-mark presentation from the other editions.
